    The radical of a vertex projective of a piece #

    Assume Lemma 4.2 for the piece (ParEq). For a point x and y, pbvec x y is the value of the composite x → y in the piece algebra; every path word from x to y equals it (pmk_word_eq_bvec), it is nonzero iff the composite is (bvec_ne_zero), and e_y a b_z vanishes unless y is reached from z with nonzero composite (corner_bvec).
